LIBRARIAN-OVERFISHING_POWER.title: Overfishing
LIBRARIAN-OVERFISHING_POWER.description:

At the start of the next several turns, double its value.

LIBRARIAN-BLAZING_CHAPTER_POWER.descript:
At the end of your turn, lose ALL [gold]Tide[/gold], then ALL [gold]Growth[/gold]. Gain [gold]Fire[/gold] equal to the total lost.
Then [gold]Settle[/gold] the [gold]Fire[/gold] Orb {Amount} extra times.

LIBRARIAN-ANCIENT_CATALOG_POWER.title: Ancient Catalog
LIBRARIAN-ANCIENT_CATALOG_POWER.descript: Whenever the [gold]Growth[/gold] Orb is [gold]Activated[/gold] or [gold]Growth[/gold] is gained, [gold]Strengthen[/gold] a random other Orb by {Amount}.

At the end of your turn, top up the [gold]Tide[/gold] Orb's [gold]Block[/gold] for this end turn to the [gold]Waves[/gold] you had before ending your turn.
Then halve your [gold]Waves[/gold].
